question: Which type of forest is most commonly home to the Royal Bengal tiger?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangrove Forests**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mangrove Forests** are the most commonly home to the Royal Bengal tiger.
 
• The Sundarbans, which is the largest mangrove forest in the world, is the primary habitat of the Royal Bengal tiger.
